🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: VXX (1W: +2.88% | 1M: -7.08%) RECOVERY showing rising short-term fear and HYG (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -1.04%) & LQD (1W: -1.12% | 1M: -1.70%) BELOW TREND signaling rising credit stress; SPY (1W: -1.21% | 1M: -2.19%) BELOW TREND adds equity weakness.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit stress rising: Credit Spread (0.7529; 1W: +0.38% | 1M: +0.10%) ABOVE TREND and HYG/LQD deterioration. Fear creeping up via VXX (1W: +2.88% | 1M: -7.08%) RECOVERY and narrow sector breadth (4/11) amplifies downside risk.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-tight: Dollar strength sitting above trend (Dollar Level 28.17; 1W: +0.64% | 1M: +0.25%) ABOVE TREND while yield dynamics show TLT (1W: -1.56% | 1M: -1.63%) BELOW TREND and Yield Curve (0.9950; 1W: -1.16% | 1M: +0.38%) CORRECTION — conditions not easing.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Energy leading: XLE (1W: +0.73% | 1M: +5.68%) ABOVE TREND while Financials XLF (sector breadth -1.95% 1W) and Industrials XLI (1W: -3.05% | 1M: -8.54%) BELOW TREND. Tech XLK (1W: -1.60% | 1M: -3.40%) BELOW TREND; style mixed / no clear leadership.

5. US vs Global?
US equities soft: SPY (1W: -1.21% | 1M: -2.19%) BELOW TREND. EM weakness concentrated: EEM (1W: -3.94% | 1M: -1.03%) BELOW TREND and China FXI (1W: -2.90% | 1M: -0.06%) BELOW TREND.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Mixed/speculative has pockets of strength but uneven: IBIT (1W: -1.08% | 1M: +24.69%) CORRECTION while small caps IWM (1W: -2.74% | 1M: -5.14%) BELOW TREND showing risk aversion.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Broad commodity rally centered on energy and selective ags: BNO (1W: +10.78% | 1M: +24.97%) ABOVE TREND and USO (1W: +10.36% | 1M: +25.30%) ABOVE TREND, while industrial metals CPER (1W: -4.23% | 1M: -3.99%) BELOW TREND.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy strength confirmed: XLE (1W: +0.73% | 1M: +5.68%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +10.78% | 1M: +24.97%) ABOVE TREND; natural gas UNG (1W: -2.18% | 1M: +3.61%) CORRECTION — watch divergence within energy complex.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed signals: credit stress (HYG & LQD BELOW TREND) and rising VXX (1W: +2.88% | 1M: -7.08%) RECOVERY. Divergences are MINOR: IBIT, ARKK, CORN and several commodity ETFs show 1W vs 1M mismatches but core equity/bond ETFs do not show MAJOR divergence.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Reduce exposure to cyclical and small-cap risk (IWM (1W: -2.74% | 1M: -5.14%) BELOW TREND; XLI (1W: -3.05% | 1M: -8.54%) BELOW TREND) and monitor credit (HYG/LQD); favor energy exposure via XLE (1W: +0.73% | 1M: +5.68%) ABOVE TREND while keeping overall positioning cautious.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +0.73% | 1M: +5.68%) ABOVE TREND, BNO (1W: +10.78% | 1M: +24.97%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: SOXX (1W: -4.32% | 1M: -9.69%) BELOW TREND, IWM (1W: -2.74% | 1M: -5.14%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: USO (1W: +10.36% | 1M: +25.30%) ABOVE TREND, BNO (1W: +10.78% | 1M: +24.97%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: CPER (1W: -4.23% | 1M: -3.99%) BELOW TREND, GLD (1W: -3.42% | 1M: -1.53%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
VXX 18.23 (1W: +1.33% | 1M: -6.51%) RECOVERY as short-term fear barometer; Credit Spread/HYG-LQD ~0.7529 (1W: +0.38% | 1M: +0.10%) ABOVE TREND for credit watch; SPY/TLT 9.4017 (1W: +0.90% | 1M: -1.39%) RECOVERY for risk-vs-duration signal; XLK/XLF 3.2313 (1W: -1.45% | 1M: -2.24%) BELOW TREND as style pivot.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive, confirmed by rising VXX (1W: +2.88% | 1M: -7.08%) RECOVERY and credit stress (HYG 1W: -0.80% | 1M: -1.04% BELOW TREND; LQD 1W: -1.12% | 1M: -1.70% BELOW TREND). Energy (XLE (1W: +0.73% | 1M: +5.68%) ABOVE TREND; BNO (1W: +10.78% | 1M: +24.97%) ABOVE TREND) showing relative strength while semis/tech and small caps show weakness; monitor credit spreads and IBIT/commodity divergences as key risks.
